Occurrence Remarks: This species is the Hibbertia scandens, from the Dilleniaceae family and Hibbertia genus. Dilleniaceae consists of species with alternate, simple and entire leaves. Its flowers are actinomorphic and mostly yellow, with 5 sepals and 5 petals. The genus Hibbertia contains flowers with stamens that are numerous and free - its filaments are not united into a tube. The species Hibbertia scandens is a climbing species with long stems. Its leaves are obovate, simple, base tapering and are arranged alternately along the stem. Its leaf margins are entire. Its flowers are yellow, with numerous stamens surrounding few carpels.
